items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: And then we had Paul Chambers later on.

ctx.x: Well he wasn’t really a pioneer. My parents had the record and that’s how I got that. But the first people like I think I mentioned before that I heard, it was like you know Bird and Bud and Miles and Tommy Flanagan, Arthur Taylor, Max Roach, some of my favorite
people. I guess I’m not naming bass players. They change so much. And then we had Paul Chambers later on. So I liked the piano and the sax and drums most, until I started like that.
You’ve had some marvelous bass players on your recordings over the years.
